label: Bible Study
prompt: Behold, I will do a _____ thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verse: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
note: God tells his people to stop staring at the past — he's making roads in wildernesses now.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be _____ in the land of my affliction.
verse: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
note: Joseph names his second son Ephraim: God made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.

label: Sunday School
prompt: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and _____ star.
verse: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
note: Near the Bible's last page, Jesus names himself the root and offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.

label: Deep Water
prompt: If thou hast run with the _____, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
verse: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
note: Jeremiah complained about his troubles; God answered that things were going to get harder.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Because _____ against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
verse: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
note: When the 'sentence' against an evil work is delayed, hearts fill with nerve to do more. Justice delayed emboldens.
